correctness.rationale: For uniform invertible n-by-n matrices over F_2, automorphisms reduce to simultaneous coordinate permutations: invertibility makes supports of images of distinct natural basis vectors disjoint, and F_2 has no nontrivial units. The transposition rank-one square-zero centralizer has exactly 2^(2n-3)|GL_(n-2)(2)| elements. Counting fixed matrix-position orbits for other permutations, bounding transposition intersections by the products, and applying Bonferroni supports the explicit n>=32 bound |p_n-t_n|<=250 n^3 2^(-3n). Independently checked GL_2=6, GL_3=168, GL_4=20160, their transposition-fixed counts 2,8,192, and GL_5 centralizer 21504. These finite checks corroborate, not prove, the n>=32 bound. Normalization is uniform on labeled invertible matrices, not classes.
